rebuild.calibration_rule: Retain every explicit r4 image reference, all nonnumeric/unknown frame names, and any orphan camera artifact. Qualification artifacts outside r4 are untouched. No calibrated geometry or external qualification is inferred from visual windows.
rebuild.numerical_consumers: Aggregate analysis consumes compact result/manifests. diagnostics consumes event and full precision motion streams. continuity consumes event/state/restart and provenance/calibration records. None reads r4 PNG/NPZ pixel bodies.
rebuild.reason: evidence_adapter.read_run applies 2Hz/parent-linked/final selection before artifact_ref reads any pixel body; selected_trace source hashes cover manifest/events/motion/result/terminal only. Existing packages authenticate exact selected image identities.
